requirements: R1: Patch task synchronization to accurately reflect GitHub PR closure without merge instead of falsely marking tasks as done

slices.title: Patch backend sync logic to correctly handle unmerged PR closures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the GitHub webhook/sync processing for this epic, I want to differentiate between a merged PR and a PR closed without merging, so that the internal task status correctly reflects the real outcome.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PR webhook payload indicates the PR was closed without merge
When the system evaluates the payload
Then it must not transition the task status to done
Given the implementation slice
When QA verification tests are run
Then they must validate the new logic correctly handles both merged and unmerged PRs
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' task statuses from PR closures by 100%
